result:
I added a per-phase setting, "Comitê pode ver formulários individuais de outros membros". When it's on, committee members can see the other members' individual forms on an application. Nothing was run or tested, and I didn't run the migration.

- **Behaviour:** the setting is off by default, so existing phases behave as before. When it's on, other members' individual forms appear read-only, so a member can't edit someone else's scores. The change is in `prepare_application_forms` in `app/models/admissions/admission_phase.rb`.
- **Setting:** the new column is `committee_can_see_other_members` on `admission_phases`. It's added to the phase form in `admission_phases_controller.rb` and labelled in the pt-BR locale file.
- **Migration:** I wrote `db/migrate/20241210000000_add_committee_can_see_members_to_admission_phases.rb` and edited `db/schema.rb` by hand to match. You'll need to run `rails db:migrate`, which should leave the schema as I edited it.

I didn't touch the professor permissions in `ability.rb`. The application form view doesn't seem to check them for individual forms. If other members' scores still don't show up, that's the first place to look.
